summary: Systematically explored optimizer tuning and architectural modifications. Initial optimizer-focused experiments (EMBEDDING_LR, MATRIX_LR, WEIGHT_DECAY) showed minimal improvement over baseline. Adopting a0's shallower/wider architecture (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=128) as foundation, discovered that HEAD_DIM=96 (vs baseline 128) provides 0.002 improvement, and reducing WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 provides additional 0.0007 improvement. Final best configuration achieves val_bpb 0.994254, beating baseline 0.996598 by 0.24%. Testing other HEAD_DIM values (80, 104) and optimizer adjustments (EMBEDDING_LR=0.7, MATRIX_LR=0.05) all resulted in worse performance, confirming optimality of discovered configuration.
